newsitem.title: CANADA: Westcoast sets bonds due 2006 and 2026.
newsitem.headline: Westcoast sets bonds due 2006 and 2026.

text.p: Westcoast Energy Inc on Tuesday set a C$125 million 6.45 percent bond due 2006 and a C$125 million 7.30 percent bond due 2026, said lead underwriter RBC Dominion Securities Inc.
The 6.45 percent bond was priced at C$99.847 with an offering yield of 6.471 percent and a spread of 45 basis points over the Government of Canada 7.0 percent bond due December, 2006.
The 7.30 percent bond was priced at C$99.952 with an offering yield of 7.304 percent and a spread of 56 basis points over the Canada 8.0 percent bond due June 2027.
The bonds, which pay interest on June 18 and December 18, will be dated and delivered on December 18.
